common_old_to_new_patterns.new_value: The Southeast Seminole Heights Drainage Basin, a historic 779‑acre urban area dating back to the early 1900s, experiences widespread flooding due to failing and undersized stormwater conveyance systems. A recent drainage study identified multiple improvement projects, and a subsequent feasibility study refined those recommendations. The City has since advanced these improvements into design and construction phases throughout the basin. The project includes approximately 16,300 linear feet of new stormwater culverts with associated laterals, inlets, system interconnections, and utility conflict‑resolution relocations. It also incorporates transportation‑related elements, sustainability treatment components, and upgrades to existing water infrastructure. In addition, the project will replace roughly 11,700 linear feet of water mains located outside the stormwater construction corridors. common_old_to_new_patterns.new_value: This project provides for the complete rehabilitation of Sulphur Springs Pumping Station at 7902 N. 13th St. The project will serve to rehabilitate the existing wet-dry type pumping station. This project will include replacement of pumps, piping, valves, and electrical improvements to ensure continued reliability of the station. The project also includes the installation of a backup generator to maintain station operation in the event of a power loss.
common_old_to_new_patterns.old_value: This project provides for the complete rehabilitation of Sulphur Springs Pumping Station at 7902 N. 13th St. The project will serve to replace the existing wet-dry type pumping station with a more efficient, reliable, and serviceable submersible pumping station. It includes demolition of above ground building structure, pumps and electrical equipment and installation of new submersible pumps, piping, valves, control panel and electrical upgrades. The new electrical and control equipment will be installed aboveground and will be designed to provide protection from flooding and wind damage associated with storm events. The project also includes the installation of a backup generator to maintain station operation in the event of a power loss.
